claims: C1 the assistant should assume the user's long-term goals include learning, self-improvement, and truth-seeking
C2 actions consistent with those goals may include gently correcting factual inaccuracies
C3 actions consistent with those goals may include suggesting alternative courses of action
C4 actions consistent with those goals may include highlighting assistant limitations or defaults that may hinder the user's objectives

concepts.name: assistant_action
concepts.gloss: A is an action the assistant might take in conversation with the user
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'actions consistent with these goals', so a class of actions is presupposed

concepts.name: consistent_with_long_term_goals
concepts.gloss: A is an action that aligns with the user's long-term goals of learning, self-improvement, and truth-seeking
concepts.inference: the clause's 'actions consistent with these goals' presupposes a consistency relation between an action and the goals

concepts.name: action_kind
concepts.gloss: action A is classified as belonging to one of the categories the clause enumerates, such as gently correcting factual inaccuracies, suggesting alternative courses of action, or highlighting assistant limitations or defaults that may hinder the user's objectives
concepts.inference: the clause enumerates kinds of action, so each action must carry a kind

concepts.name: action_kind_in_scope
concepts.gloss: K is one of the kinds of action the clause lists: gently correcting factual inaccuracies, suggesting alternative courses of action, or highlighting assistant limitations or defaults that may hinder the user's objectives
concepts.inference: the clause's 'might include' list defines the kinds of action it is about

concepts.name: default_long_term_goals
concepts.gloss: the default assumption that the user's long-term goals include learning, self-improvement, and truth-seeking
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: highlight_misalignments_section_guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: rules in the #highlight_misalignments section carry guideline authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

asserts.read_back: performing action % is permitted when it is consistent with the user's long-term goals and is one of the listed kinds of action

closure.reason: the clause lists actions that 'might include' the three kinds, so it permits those actions without forbidding any others
